title: Where several financial pressures could meet
authorization: Will: Okay well we should further investigate these other areas more thoroughly too
completion_scope: Four substantive research reviews completed and integrated. This is the first bounded investigation, not a claim that every exposure or future event is resolved.
main_judgment: The strongest current evidence concerns property refinancing and identifiable weak borrowers. Private credit, insurer funding and AI contracts supply plausible routes for stress to spread. We have not established a simultaneous financial-system funding break or a priced trade advantage.

research_priorities.priority: First: closest to observed borrower losses
research_priorities.finding: More commercial mortgages entered workout management in September. Existing OZK and FLG evidence identifies real property exposure. FHLB collateral capacity remains substantial in aggregate, while a smaller borrower tail has thin capacity.
research_priorities.decisive_question: At the same bank, do new property losses coincide with weaker cash earnings, more expensive deposits and less usable collateral?
research_priorities.counterevidence: RaDD obtained an executed multiyear extension and new capital. FLG June liquidity exceeded adjusted uninsured deposits. Neither is a current blanket assurance, but both weaken immediate forced-sale claims.
research_priorities.gap: October bank-specific funding restrictions, haircuts and forced sales are not jointly established.

research_priorities.area: Private credit, corporate refinancing and insurers
research_priorities.priority: First: inspect cash and collateral at named entities
research_priorities.finding: Kellermeyer/FSK provides a specific case of noncash interest, impaired value and pledged collateral. Insurer funding and bank credit lines create connections, but their size does not establish loss.
research_priorities.decisive_question: Does weaker borrower cash flow reduce the fund's borrowing base or make the insurer draw credit, sell assets or restrict cash payments?
research_priorities.counterevidence: Some marks and bank exposures remain relatively sound; strong corporate issuers have greater debt-service capacity. Redemption limits can protect remaining investors from forced sales.
research_priorities.gap: Current retained lender shares, borrowing-base reductions, DLIC post-pause flows and current Citizens revolver use remain unresolved.

research_priorities.finding: Power costs, customer acceptance and project delays can change cash available for debt service. Some guarantees and future leases shift risk outside headline corporate debt.
research_priorities.decisive_question: Who must pay cash if a project is late, underused or more expensive, and which institution actually retains that obligation?
research_priorities.counterevidence: CoreWeave closed new financing. Its project contract has power protections whose percentages are redacted; unhedged exposure cannot be assumed material from wording alone.
research_priorities.gap: Actual hedge shares, draws, purchase-obligation balance and ultimate retained exposures remain UNKNOWN.

research_priorities.priority: Second: connect borrower strain to lenders
research_priorities.finding: September NFIB financing costs rose; small-business reorganizations increased. Personal guarantees connect business failures to household balance sheets. Higher mortgage rates can impair new purchases and refinancing.
research_priorities.decisive_question: Which lender's customers are newly falling behind, and are actual losses outpacing cash earnings and existing reserves?
research_priorities.counterevidence: Loan-access indicators are mixed; many firms have no debt. New card delinquencies are much more stable than the headline accumulated delinquency stock suggests.
research_priorities.gap: A current borrower-to-lender loss map is incomplete. Enova is a bounded research candidate, not an established short or new standing monitor.

research_priorities.area: Pensions, Treasury/repo leverage and cross-market cash demands
research_priorities.finding: Pension asset losses, actuarial funding and urgent cash needs are separate. Leveraged positions and margin calls can force sales even when long-run solvency is adequate. Pension annuity transfers move obligations into insurers.
research_priorities.decisive_question: For a named plan or fund, do benefits, capital calls and collateral demands exceed liquid resources?
research_priorities.counterevidence: Pension funding can improve as discount rates rise. Preliminary CalPERS evidence is stronger, not weaker. Retrieved repo observations through October9 show functioning aggregate funding.
research_priorities.gap: No named current US pension forced sale established. Pension-sector owner remains unidentified; PROME retains this coverage question. Repo data are dated and do not clear individual funds.

combined_scenarios.scenario: Rates remain high while property and business cash flow weaken
combined_scenarios.mechanism: Refinancing shortfalls create new credit recognition; weaker earnings absorb less funding-cost pressure. Funding trouble requires an additional loss of available cash or collateral capacity.
combined_scenarios.disconfirmation: Cash paydowns, fresh sponsor capital, stable cheap deposits and sustained lender capacity.

combined_scenarios.mechanism: Bond marks may improve while loan defaults worsen. A rate decline therefore need not rescue weak-credit institutions, but securities and credit losses cannot be assumed to worsen together.
combined_scenarios.disconfirmation: Lower debt service and stable income cure arrears faster than collateral weakens.

combined_scenarios.scenario: Asset losses coincide with redemption or margin demands
combined_scenarios.mechanism: An illiquid fund, insurer or leveraged trader may need cash before assets mature. Shared lenders and collateral can transmit pressure.
combined_scenarios.disconfirmation: Available unrestricted cash, matched long-term liabilities, effective hedges and fresh financing prevent forced sales.

evidence_rules: Follow borrower -> legal creditor -> retained exposure -> cash obligation -> financing -> incremental loss.
Keep announced size, committed amount, drawn balance, guarantee and actual loss separate.
Do not add a property loan, its securitization, insurer holding and bank facility as independent losses.
Retain publication dates and observation dates. June balance sheets are not October positions.
A new trade needs an expectations gap, catalyst and viable instrument economics; vulnerability alone is insufficient.
